## NSXL for Windows 1.4.2

- Fixed the quick menu not opening during games with a PS5 controller over Bluetooth. Games like Horizon switch the controller into its full mode (for haptics and adaptive triggers). NSXL didn't recognise a Bluetooth DualSense in that mode, so it ignored every button until the game closed. The PS button and Create + Options now work in-game too.
- The log now notes when a game switches the controller's mode.
